name: Zebras - Grant's Zebra Braying
description:
In media such as the online game, "Snorin" and "The Lion Guard", zebras are depicted neighing like a horse when in reality, in the case of the Grant's zebra as heard here, they don't, but rather, they make this bray sound comparable to a small dog bark.

Grant's zebras are a subspecies of common (or plains) zebra and are the smallest of these ornate black-and-white equids. They migrate alongside wildebeests in the Masai Mara migration.

Recorded with an LG Stylus 2022.

name: VOC_190213-1342_HK_Stoplight.wav
description:
Typical sound of a stoplight in Hong Kong. 
In Hong Kong city, stoplights are equipped with a buzzer which makes different kind of noise to help blind people to cross the streets. 
In this file, I intended to record the typical sound of one of them at Nathan Road. In the background, you can also hear traffic in the street and pedestrians’ voices. 
Recorded in February 2019 with an Olympus LS-100 (internal microphones). 
Fade in/out applied in Audacity.

name: Zebra finches ZFB-011
description:
Zebra finches recorded in the lab. A couple of dozen of them, in two very large cages, tweeting, flapping around.

Recorded in high quality: 96 kHz 24-bit, using a matched pair of AKG C451B microphones, to a Zoom H4n recorder. 11th April 2014.

The metallic sound in the background is the cage, resonating to the birds' flapping and to the ventilation.
